title: Grid Substation Specifications
description: Schema for data/substation_specs.csv, the structured inventory of Nepal's 66-400 kV grid substations (operating, under construction and planned). CSV cells are strings; 'number' fields must parse as numbers. Multi-valued fields use ';' as separator.

slug.description: Unique kebab-case slug. Reuses an existing wiki entity slug where one exists; otherwise '<name>-substation'. An entity page is not required.

substation_name.description: Substation name as listed by NEA (spelling normalised only where noted in 'notes').

highest_voltage_kv.description: Highest in-service transformation voltage for operating rows; highest designed voltage for under-construction and planned rows.

voltage_ratios.description: ';'-separated transformer ratios in kV (e.g. '220/132;132/33'). In-service ratios only for operating rows; future ratios are described in 'notes'.

installed_mva.description: Sum of all transformer capacity listed under the substation in the NEA FY 2082/83 existing-substation table, including 33/11 kV and 66/11 kV units. Blank when the substation is not in service.

planned_additional_mva.description: Sum of the totals printed for this substation in the NEA under-construction and planned/proposed substation tables.

status_as_of.description: Date the status refers to (end of the source reporting period).

province.description: Province, derived from a sourced or canonical-geography district lookup. Blank when unknown or spanning multiple provinces.

district.description: District from a primary source or canonical Nepal administrative geography lookup (basis recorded in notes).

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude copied from a local spatial asset (rpgcl_substation_nodes.geojson, place_anchor_index.geojson or the OpenStreetMap Geofabrik extract) by scripts/geocode_infrastructure_assets.py; basis recorded in notes. Never estimated.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude, same basis as latitude.

coordinate_precision.description: official-map-node = substation symbol position on the RPGCL official transmission network GeoPDF (data/processed/maps/rpgcl_substation_nodes.geojson; symbol-level, ~1 km); approximate-place = Nominatim or OpenStreetMap place-level match for the named town/village, not the substation footprint.

corridor_slugs.description: ';'-separated wiki slugs of transmission corridors or cross-border interconnections terminating at or passing through the substation.

cross_border_link.description: Cross-border interconnection whose Nepal-side terminal is this substation, with counterpart country and non-operating status where applicable.

linked_solar_award_mw.description: Generated by scripts/build_substation_specs_links.py: sum of capacity_mw of data/solar_project_specs.csv rows whose 'substation' name matches this substation.

commissioned_year.description: AD year of a dated commissioning/charging statement in a source. Blank when no dated statement is on file.

source_slug.description: Wiki page slug of the primary source (usually a wiki/pages/sources page).

source_locator.description: Table/section and printed + PDF page locators.

confidence.description: Confidence in the row's capacity and status fields.

last_updated.description: Date the row was last verified or updated.

notes.description: Transformer breakdown, future works, location/district basis and caveats.
